## Why it is a defect

It is the **same falsified premise** that PR #16930 is removing from `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` under card #15777. That card's finding, in short: the aggregated shape of `droppedFields` was justified by *"schema-uniform, so every row drops the same set"*, and **ruling C's per-row hook exemption falsifies that premise** — the strip is no longer uniform across rows, so the sentence states as live a fact the code contradicts.

The `packages/spec` copy is being corrected. This copy is not, and it is the same claim about the same mechanism.

⚠️ **One difference worth carrying, measured rather than assumed:** the `metadata-protocol` sentence is softened by a following parenthetical noting that since #14147 the strip reports one event per call. So this may be a *partial* correction rather than a wholesale rewrite — read the whole docblock before deciding, and ⛔ do not copy #15777's replacement wording without checking it fits this call site.

## Why it was not folded into PR #16930

Correcting it there would have added `packages/metadata-protocol` to that PR's verification surface, and the dispatching seat had capped that fold at three members precisely so each member stays independently reviewable. The dev noted it, dedup'd it with a live control, found no card recording it, and handed it back — which is the right handling of an out-of-scope neighbour.

## Dedup

The delivering dev ran dedup with a live positive control on the same channel and found no existing card. ⚠️ Stated as its reading, not re-run by this seat — the sentence's presence on `origin/main` above **is** this seat's reading.

## Suggested acceptance criterion (⛔ a suggestion, not a prescription)

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` no longer asserts, as live, that the create-side static-`readonly` strip is uniform across rows — with the ruling-C exemption named as the reason, and with the #14147 parenthetical either kept or folded in, whichever the whole docblock needs.

⭐ Whatever replaces it is itself load-bearing prose: it should say what is true **today** and cite the artefact that makes it true, never a schedule. #15777 exists because a sentence justified a shape with a premise that later stopped holding.
